text:
maria: Quick sync — need a packaging matrix for private deploys. Customers keep asking which distros we'll support, how offline license activation works, and the upgrade/rollback story. Need this for Q3/Q4 roadmap planning.
kevin: Can we scope GA to a small set? RHEL 8/9, Ubuntu 22.04, Rocky would cover most. Packaging: RPM/DEB + an all-in-one tarball for airgap.
ash: +1. Prioritize RHEL/Centos replacements and Ubuntu. Tarball installer for on‑prem, plus terraform modules for VPC control plane. Need to decide if we will provide instructions for customers to host local apt/yum mirrors.
sara: Security note — air-gapped must have signed artifacts, reproducible builds, and offline checksum verification. Offline KMS option rather than cloud KMS is a hard requirement for some customers.
devon: Operational concerns: upgrade path should support canary -> staggered rollout -> automatic rollback hook. For airgap we need an "offline upgrade bundle" with pre/post hooks and a smoke-test. Suggest nightly build artifacts retained for N days.
maria: Customer asks: fintech + medtech want upgrade audit logs and signed manifests, plus ability to pin immutable versions per env. Feasible?
kevin: Feasible. We'll add manifest signing + attestations. That adds CI/build pipeline work — estimate ~3 eng sprints for basic offline bundle + signing, plus test coverage.
sara: Also loop in legal for export control review if we bundle certain crypto/HSM integrations.
maria: @legal-bot can you confirm process? @deploy-bot what's the ETA for CI/pipeline changes?
legal-bot: cc @maria — need a short spec of crypto usage and distribution targets to start review. Expect 7-10 business days for initial review.
deploy-bot: Pipeline work: produce tarball artifacts, manifest signing, and mirror steps. Target: initial PR in 2 weeks. CI additions for reproducible builds required.
ash: Decision point: support online repo mirror (customer-run mirror) vs full offline bundle. Both increase scope. My vote: GA = offline bundle + terraform modules; add mirror tooling post-GA.
devon: Agree. Also define offering: self-service vs managed upgrade for private customers. SLA/assist should be a commercial option.
maria: Draft GA acceptance criteria proposal: (1) Signed artifacts + manifest + checksums (2) Offline upgrade bundle with docs & smoke-tests (3) Installer supports RHEL8/9 and Ubuntu22.04 (4) Terraform modules for VPC control plane (5) Audit logs & upgrade tracing for rollouts. Anything missing?
kevin: Add automated CI tests for upgrade/rollback matrix.
sara: Add docs for KMS/HSM integration and option for customer-managed keys.
devon: :thumbsup: I'll draft the canary/rollback runbook and minimal smoke-test steps.
maria: Action items: Kevin -> 3 sprints for bundle/signing; Nash -> finalize distro/packaging formats; Devon -> runbook + tests; Sara -> legal handoff; Maria -> fold into roadmap doc and OKR. Sync Wed 10am.
nash: I'll post distro + packaging matrix by EOD tomorrow.
kevin: Noted, adding tickets to eng backlog.
maria: :calendar: Wed 10am — invite sent.
